mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-significant positive 20d returns (p > 0.05) in a 12-month window despite a sustained FEDFUNDS decline below 5.25.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 4.5% triggers a labor market strengthening effect, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 4.5 or 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly supply index (INDPRO) signals robust demand and production capacity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and INDPRO move in opposite directions or their combined effect does not correlate with positive 20d returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 5.25% triggers accommodative monetary policy, lowering long-term interest rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not decline below 5.25 in late-cycle expansion or 20d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) over time reflects growing economic activity, which enhances corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not show a sustained upward trend over 12 months or 5d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 5.25% signals tightening monetary policy, increasing borrowing costs and pressuring equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not exceed 5.25 or 20d returns are positive when FEDFUNDS rises above 5.25.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in labor employment (PAYEMS) coupled with a decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE increases (opposite directions) or their combined effect does not correlate with positive 60d returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a surge in the supply index (INDPRO) above 112.6889 indicates improved production capacity, reducing inflationary pressures and supporting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not exceed 112.6889 in post-shock recovery or 5d returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
